asks: Where did the numbers in this film come from, and can you check them?
source: lab/film/welcome/qc/tokens.cjs — every figure is an expression over a live file, never a typed digit
narration: The last frame is a command rather than a logo. That one re-measures every number this film renders. Run it after you clone. If your output disagrees with what you have just watched, the film is wrong, and we would want the receipt.
